name: Awei Most Demanding Product Awei Pa-13 22.5w 50000maH Fast Charging Powerbank
description:
Keep your devices powered longer with the Awei 50,000mAh Power Bank, designed for heavy power users, travelers, and professionals. With dual USB ports, multiple safety protections, and a slim portable design, it ensures you never run out of power on the go.

Key Features:

🔋 Massive 50,000mAh Capacity – Enough power to charge smartphones, tablets, laptops, and more multiple times.

⚡ Dual USB Output (5V/2.1A) – Charge two devices simultaneously with fast and efficient power delivery.

💡 LED Battery Indicators – 4 LED lights clearly display the remaining charge.

👜 Portable & Lightweight Design – Compact size (155 x 75 x 25mm) and 520g weight makes it travel-ready.

🔒 Safe Charging Technology – Built-in protection against overcharge, overheating, and short circuits.

Specifications:

Brand: Awei

Capacity: 50,000mAh

Input: 5V/2A

Output: 5V/2.1A (2 USB ports)

Battery Type: Lithium Polymer

Charging Time: 12–14 hours

Dimensions: 155mm x 75mm x 25mm

Weight: 520g

Compatibility: Phones, tablets, laptops & other USB-powered devices

6-Month Official Warranty
